content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Forbes's PostForbes Verified account6d · Shared with PublicThe Education Department may be required to discharge the student loans for thousands of student loan borrowers after a critical deadline passed on Wednesday. If the discharges ultimately go through, it would be the final cohort of approvals for borrowers eligible for relief under the Sweet v. McMahon settlement agreement.But even as Wednesday’s important deadline passed, the legal battle over the Sweet v. McMahon settlement agreement continues.
